field_changes.old: Your adaptive plan's week preview now shows exactly why exercises were swapped — injury, difficulty, or equipment — grouped by movement pattern in a new update card. The activity feed refreshes instantly when you delete a logged session too. Empty weeks in the weekly review now correctly show No Data, and onboarding is streamlined so new members get to their first workout faster. Plus a handful of bug fixes.
field_changes.new: Your interval timer now stays in sync between your phone and Apple Watch during Traditional workouts — start it on either device and the other mirrors it instantly. The solo contest leaderboard is now a clean ranked list showing rank, name, and points. New Adaptive Plan members can pick their training days by day of the week, with workout reminders at 5 PM. Plus a few bug fixes and visual polish.
